limitations: Synthetic frozen evaluation cases, excluded from prompts and tuning fixtures; not an external benchmark or real-user distribution.
Legacy support is credited only for complete verbatim gold spans with matching layer provenance; legacy has no source-range receipts.
Offline span support is evidence reachability, not answer quality. Live exact-match reader scores are diagnostic and require review.
No dense or reranker quality gain is inferred from lexical recall results.
Verification and development share templates; these are not independently authored or external QA benchmarks.
Concurrent local builds/tests may affect latency; these timings are not an isolated performance benchmark.
The 40 abstention cases have no positive gold spans; offline support does not grade appropriate reader abstention.
peak_memory_note: measure externally with /usr/bin/time -l; never inferred from file size
evaluation_partition: synthetic verification; disjoint trajectory labels; shared templates with development
